audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 was given to Volibear in both layers while whys[1] says outright that Sett wins level 2. packet.levelChart and the mirror audit both also give Level 2 to Sett.
audit.why: Sett at level 2 has Knuckle Down plus a gritted Haymaker before Frenzied Maul's re-bite heal exists — the one row he clearly takes.
audit.corrected: Row 1 flipped to Sett in both layers, rating 6/10 to 4/10. Rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 left alone: the mirror wants Sett there too, but packet.levelChart contradicts it on a 54.34% lane, so I did not guess.

audit.why: Spike order is right — Sett's level-2 grit window, your 3-6 all-in, then your item grind out-scaling his front-loaded burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: Facebreaker was written as an unconditional stun ('Get E-stunned') and once as a root.
audit.why: Facebreaker pulls enemies on OPPOSITE sides of Sett and stuns them. If everything caught is on one side, they are slowed instead. In a solo lane that means the stun requires a minion or ally on his far side — stand on the same side as the wave and it is only a slow. It never roots.
audit.corrected: Stated the both-sides condition and gave real cooldowns: Facebreaker 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Haymaker 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, The Show Stopper 120/100/80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Your Relentless Storm' and 'Relentless Storm' for Volibear's passive; 'Show Stopper' for Sett's R.
audit.why: Riot's names are The Relentless Storm and The Show Stopper.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — His shield + true-damage burst. All-in after it. Track it before every engage. - Sett Facebreaker: Pulls enemies on both sides together and stuns if hit from both sides. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Sett Haymaker: 18s at rank 1, a shield plus true damage — all-in once he spends it. - Sett Facebreaker: 16s at rank 1, and it only stuns if you are on the opposite side from another enemy; alone you are just slowed.

edits.after: Grit decays and Haymaker is 18s at rank 1 — trade after he spends it, never into it.

edits.after: The Relentless Storm and your first bruiser item give you the DPS edge in a grind; Sett needs Facebreaker (E) to trade evenly, and it is down 16s at rank 1 once you sidestep it.
